THE SIGNATURE EIGHT ✨

Moving beyond custom cakes in 2026 to now introduce a curated lineup of eight signature cupcakes — each crafted to deliver the perfect balance of sponge, filling, and frosting in every bite.

Swipe to see the lineup and explore each flavor below ⬇️

🍪 BISCOFF CRUNCH
A tribute to the world’s favorite airplane cookie. Fluffy vanilla bean cake atop a buttery Biscoff crust, filled with whipped Biscoff cream and finished with cookie butter frosting.

🌹 GULAB JAMUN
A syrup-soaked gulab jamun hidden inside a fragrant cardamom-infused cake, crowned with ultra-light whipped cream, crushed pistachios, and a pipette of rose syrup.

☕️ CARAMEL MACCHIATO
Your Starbucks order, but in cake form. Vanilla bean sponge filled with buttery caramel and topped with espresso-infused buttercream.

🔥 TOASTED S’MORE
Deep chocolate cake with a gooey whipped marshmallow center, swirled with graham cracker buttercream and finished with marshmallow, graham cracker, and Hershey’s chocolate.

🍓 STRAWBERRY SHORTCAKE
Vanilla sponge filled with fresh strawberry compote, topped with pillowy whipped cream and signature strawberry crunch. (Use the tres leches pipette for a melt-in-your-mouth finish.)

🇮🇹 TIRAMISU MOCHA
Rich chocolate sponge layered with silky ganache and piled high with espresso–mascarpone frosting.

🍫 NUTELLA ROCHER
Chocolate cake with a molten Nutella core, topped with Nutella buttercream, crushed pecans, glossy ganache, and crowned with a Ferrero Rocher.

☁️ WHITE RASPBERRY
White chocolate chunk vanilla cake filled with bright raspberry compote, finished with white chocolate ganache and freeze-dried raspberries.

📩 DM to order or inquire — limited availability each week.
